name: select
title: Select
description: Pick one option from a short list in a dropdown, with groups, descriptions and icons.

when: One choice from about 5 to 15 options.
Several choices from a medium list.

instead.when: Fewer than 5 options should all stay visible.
The list is long and people type to find.
A few options should all stay visible.
The options should stay visible on the page, not in a dropdown.

builtIn: Announced as a button that opens a listbox.
Required fields show "Fill in this field." after a blur or a submit; your own `errorMessage` replaces it.
Each tag has a remove button named after its option.

genui.description: A dropdown for one choice. items are {id, label} options; use radio when there are fewer than 5. Emits change.
